method: Execute public APIs from the actual npm package in Node and record outputs; the independent implementation replays them. Numbers match within absolute 1e-6; rgba() strings match channel by channel within 1e-6; an error reference must also throw; null means the call returned nothing. Easing names in args stand for the Easing functions. No implementation source copied. This does not measure video rendering or React runtime parity.
